clips.title: The story
paras: The Goblin Foundry is an industrial workshop deep within the Deadmines where goblin tinkerers labored to manufacture heavy machinery for Edwin VanCleef's rebellion. Centered around a massive smelting cauldron, the chamber fell into chaos when the experimental harvest golems housed within abruptly came to life.

Carved into the subterranean depths of Moonbrook, the Goblin Foundry provided the Defias Brotherhood with the heavy manufacturing power required to fuel their uprising. Utilizing vast smelters, iron ramps, and goblin engineering expertise, the workshop mass-produced mechanical armaments. Among their most ambitious endeavors was the construction of the Foe Reaper 5000, an upgraded iteration of Westfall's familiar automated reapers.
